title: Machine Learning Intern
description: Work on machine learning models, data preprocessing, model evaluation and experimentation.

title: AI/ML Intern
description: Assist in developing AI and deep learning solutions for real-world applications.

title: Generative AI Intern
description: Build applications using large language models, RAG pipelines and AI agents.

title: Data Science Intern
description: Analyze datasets, perform exploratory data analysis and create business dashboards.
eligibility: Students with knowledge of Python, SQL and data analysis.
